problem: Given `a = 17`, `b = 5`, and `result = (a % b + b) % a`, what is the value of `result`?
solution_steps: Calculate `a % b`: `17 % 5 = 2` (17 divided by 5 is 3 with a remainder of 2).
Calculate `(a % b + b) % a`: `7 % 17 = 7` (7 divided by 17 is 0 with a remainder of 7).
